source: This is not a web or mail link. It opens another app, which may call, send a message or act for you. Open it only if you trust the sender.
text: Ehara tenei i te hononga ipurangi, mēra ranei. Ka whakatuwherahia tetahi atu taupānga, ka waea mai, ka tuku karere, ka mahi ranei maau. Whakatuwherahia mena ka whakawhirinaki koe ki te kaituku.

source: Links of this type are blocked: they can reach files, other apps' data or run code.
text: Kua aukatia nga hononga penei: ka taea e ratou te toro atu ki nga konae, ki nga raraunga o etahi atu taupānga, ki te whakahaere waehere ranei.

source: The server closed the connection when asked to push new mail (IDLE), which is a server problem. Checking for new mail every %1$d s instead.
text: I katia e te tūmau te hononga i te wā i tonohia kia pana te mēra hōu (IDLE), he raruraru tūmau. Te tirotiro mo nga mēra hou ia %1$d.

source: The server does not offer COMPRESS=DEFLATE.
text: Karekau te tūmau e tuku COMPRESS=DEFLATE.

source: Move entire folder includes deleted messages
text: Nuku kōpaki katoa kei roto nga karere kua mukua

source: Off: messages already marked deleted stay behind (UID SEARCH UNDELETED).
text: Weto: ko nga karere kua tohua kua mukua ka noho ki muri (UID SEARCH UNDELETED).
Whakaatu ana i te %1$d KB tuatahi anake.
Miramirahia nga ahua-rite me nga tuhinga whakauru
Miramirahia nga mea katoa ehara i te ASCII

source: Not sent: this server does not offer SMTPUTF8, which non-ASCII addresses or headers need (%1$s). Use an ASCII address or another server.
text: Kaore i tukuna: kaore tenei tūmau e tuku SMTPUTF8, e hiahiatia ana e nga wahitau ASCII-kore, nga pane ranei (%1$s). Whakamahia he wahitau ASCII, tetahi atu tūmau ranei.

source: Off: panels follow the screen size (Auto). This is the Auto arrangement for this screen.
text: Weto: ka whai nga panui i te rahi o te mata (Aunoa). Koinei te whakaritenga Aunoa mo tenei mata.

source: Tap a panel, then split it side by side or top and bottom, remove it, or choose what it shows.
text: Patohia he panui, katahi ka wehea ki tetahi taha, ki runga, ki raro ranei, tangohia, whiriwhirihia ranei he aha e whakaatu ana.

source: The layout needs a message list. Not saved yet.
text: Me whai rarangi karere te tahora. Kaore ano kia tiakina.

source: Each panel type can appear only once. Not saved yet.
text: Ka taea e ia momo panui te puta kotahi anake. Kaore ano kia tiakina.

source: The message panel must share a split with the message list. Not saved yet.
text: Me tiritiri te rarangi karere ki te rarangi karere. Kaore ano kia tiakina.
Kaore e taea te whakaatu i tenei tahora: %1$s

source: Not sent: these addresses contain characters SMTP cannot carry: %1$s
text: Kaore i tukuna: kei roto i enei wahitau nga tohu kaore e taea e SMTP te kawe: %1$s

source.one: %1$d existing contact has a different name, nickname or note. Addresses are only ever added. Overwrite the different values, or keep the existing ones and fill only empty fields?
source.other: %1$d existing contacts have a different name, nickname or note. Addresses are only ever added. Overwrite the different values, or keep the existing ones and fill only empty fields?

text.other: %1$d o nga hoapaki o naianei he rereke te ingoa, te ingoa karanga, te tuhipoka ranei. Ko nga wahitau ka taapiri noa. Tuhia nga uara rereke, pupuri ranei i nga uara o mua ka whakakiia nga mara putua anake?

text: Nga huringa tūmau kaore i tiakina

source: Host, host:port, or an https (or http) URL. The JMAP service is found at https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; the port is 443 unless given.
text: Kaihautū, kaihautū:tauranga, he https (http ranei) URL. Ka kitea te ratonga JMAP i https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; he 443 te tauranga ki te kore e hoatu.

source: Plain http: your password and mail travel unencrypted.
text: http mania: to kupuhipa me to mēra haere kore whakamuna.

source: This account cannot send: set an SMTP server or turn on Send over JMAP.
text: Kaore e taea e tenei kaute te tuku: tautuhia he tūmau SMTP ka whakakā ranei Tukuna ma JMAP.

source: Cyrus SASL, Carnegie Mellon University license
text: Cyrus SASL, raihana Whare Wananga o Carnegie Mellon
Ka utaina ano te rarangi kōpaki.
Ka tiango ia kōpaki kua whakaroahia.

source: Saves the current expansion as the default.
text: Ka tiakina te roha o naianei hei taunoa.
Ka whakahoki i te roha taunoa kua tiakina.

source: Opens messages kept on this device.
text: Whakatuwheratia nga karere kei runga i tenei taputapu.

source: Chooses which actions stay on the bar.
text: Ka whiriwhiri ko wai nga mahi ka noho ki te pae.
Ka timata tenei kōpaki ki te whakawhānui.

source: Selects every message in the list.
text: Ka kowhiri i nga karere katoa i te rarangi.
Ka tohu i te whiringa kua whakautua.
I whakautu a Clears i runga i te whiringa.
Kua mukua te ūkui i te tīpakonga.
Ka tāwhana i te karere kua tohua.
Ka whiriwhiri i te waahi ka tuwhera te taurangi.
Ka tango i nga karere kua tohua kua mukua.
Whakaatu ai i nga kaute o tenei kōpaki.
Ka peke ki te nama karere.
Ka whakatuwhera i te karere kare ano kia panuitia.

source: Marks the messages in this folder read.
text: Tohua nga karere o tenei kōpaki kua panuitia.
Ka whakakore i te rapunga kua tiakina.
Ka whakatuwhera i nga whiringa tātari.
Ka whakaatu i nga karere hou anake.
Hunaia nga karere kua tohua kua mukua.

source: Shows the thread of the selected message.
text: Whakaatu ai i te miro o te karere kua tohua.

source: Saves the message without deleting it.
text: Ka tiakina te karere me te kore e mukua.

source: Copies an address from the message.
text: Ka kape i tetahi wahitau mai i te karere.

source: Starts a filter from this message.
text: Ka tiimata he tātari mai i tenei karere.

source: Shows the message with dark colors.
text: Ka whakaatu i te karere me nga tae pouri.

source: Shows the message with its own colors.
text: Ka whakaatu i te karere me ona ake tae.
Ka aukati i nga whakaahua mai i tenei kaituku.
Whakaaetia nga whakaahua mai i tenei kaituku.
Ka poraka nga whakaahua mai i tenei rarangi.
Whakaaetia nga whakaahua mai i tenei rarangi.

source: Saves the message to send later.
text: Tiakina te karere hei tuku i muri mai.
Ka whiriwhiri mai i nga ture.

source: Adds or removes this folder as a favorite.
text: Ka taapiri, ka tango ranei i tenei kōpaki hei tino pai.

source: Shows the message in this view.
text: Ka whakaatu i te karere i tenei tirohanga.
Ka whakamahia tenei wahitau hei Mai.
Ka whakahaere i tenei rapunga kua tiakina.

source: Uses this field in the query.
text: Ka whakamahi i tenei mara ki te patai.

source: Limits the list to this criterion.
text: Whakawhāitihia te rārangi ki tēnei paearu.

source: Marks the selection seen or unseen.
text: Ka tohu i te kowhiringa kua kitea, kaore ranei i kitea.
Ka kara, ka wetewete ranei te tohu.

source: Allow old TLS and weak keys
text: Tukua nga TLS tawhito me nga taviri ngoikore
Tukua he kupu huna kupu marama
Timata te tuunga mo ia kōpaki

source: Move entire folder includes deleted messages
text: Nuku kōpaki katoa kei roto nga karere kua mukua

text: Ina karekau he ture-whakaoho-taumai a te pinerc
He rite ki te kupuhipa IMAP
Tiki tatau mo nga kōpaki ka kitea (he puhoi)
Nga Karere mo ia roopu momo

text: Kaua e patai ano mo tenei takahanga
Ka tatauhia te kōpaki Tāmata i muri

Nga Karere kua utaina mo ia wharangi
Kia ora-ora (NOOP mo nga hononga mangere)
Ko te ahua mamao rawa atu kua utaina
Whakautu tūmau JMAP nui rawa atu

text: Karere nui rawa atu kua whakaatuhia i te tirohanga mata
Te nuinga o nga hua rapu
Nga Karere mo ia whakahau neke
Ka mutu te panui a te tūmau mēra

source: Do not ask again for this search
text: Kaua e patai ano mo tenei rapunga

source: The account open in the drawer
text: Ka tuwhera te kaute i roto i te pouaka
Ko te kaute i whakatika whakamutunga
Kua takiuru me te kore e herea te hongere (%1$s)

source: On sends with no SMTP login
text: Ka tukuna karekau he takiuru SMTP

source: Do not ask again for this sort
text: Kaua e patai ano mo tenei ahua

text: Kaua e patai ano mo tenei miro
Whakaitihia te rahi o te raarangi waka

text: Ko nga tautuhinga mo %1$s kaore i taea te panui. Ka haere tonu te muku.

source: Same as inbound server and login
text: He rite tonu ki te tūmau whakauru me te takiuru

source: Google restore isn't available in this build; passwords are not backed up
text: Karekau a Google restore i te waatea i tenei hanga; kāore ngā kupuhipa i te pūruatia

source: Google restore needs a screen lock
text: Ko te whakaora a Google me raka mata
Kaore he kaiwhakahaere kupuhipa e waatea ana

source: The password backup is too large
text: He nui rawa te tārua kupuhipa
He maha rawa nga taapiri kupuhipa
Kaore i taea te Tatūnga te tiaki

source: These stored keys are not in this version. Remove them?
text: Ko enei mau taviri kua penapena kaore i tenei putanga. Tangohia ratou?

source: The default account was removed. Choose an account.
text: I tangohia te kaute taunoa. Kōwhiria he pūkete.

source: This account's settings could not be read.
text: Ko nga tautuhinga o tenei kaute kaore i taea te panui.
Nga ra hei pupuri i nga raarangi waka
Ko nga konae waka i puritia mo ia kaute
te rahi o te wharangi JMAP
